symbols.name: _origin
symbols.content: def _origin(url: str) -> str:     parts = urlsplit(url)     parsed_port = parts.port     port = parsed_port if parsed_port is not None else (443 if parts.scheme == "https" else 80)     if port == 0:         raise ValueError("invalid URL port")     host = parts.hostname or ""     host = f"[{host.lower()}]" if ":" in host else host.lower()     return f"{parts.scheme}://{host}:{port}"

symbols.name: _digest
symbols.content: def _digest(value: object) -> str:     return hashlib.sha256(         json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()     ).hexdigest()

symbols.name: _origin
symbols.content: def _origin(url: str) -> str:     parts = urlsplit(url)     parsed_port = parts.port     port = parsed_port if parsed_port is not None else (443 if parts.scheme == "https" else 80)     if port == 0:         raise ValueError("invalid URL port")     host = parts.hostname or ""     host = f"[{host.lower()}]" if ":" in host else host.lower()     return f"{parts.scheme}://{host}:{port}"

symbols.name: _digest
symbols.content: def _digest(value: object) -> str:     return hashlib.sha256(         json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()     ).hexdigest()
